_note: The route network as a graph. Nodes are places, edges are road segments. dataStatus 'existing' = original TRIKEFAIR distances (rules.json). dataStatus 'demo' = DEMONSTRATION segments: straight-line distance between the two stored points x roadFactor, the same estimation method the original project used. Demo segments are not surveyed and do not prove a road exists. TODO: VERIFY LOCAL ROUTE DATA.

settings._speedNote: estimated_minutes = distance_km / assumedSpeedKph. A demonstration assumption, not measured travel time.
settings._costNote: routeCost = distance x distanceWeight + minutes x timeWeight. Distance-only by default. No live traffic data is used.
settings._osmNote: dataStatus 'osm': place coordinates from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) and road distances from OSRM, retrieved 2026-10-24. Verifiable public data, not a field survey. 'existing' segments are the original TRIKEFAIR matrix and are unchanged.
